property_summary: Before Initialized() is called, every call to SetLogFile must succeed (the reentrancy lock is always released after each call), so two consecutive pre-initialization SetLogFile calls both return successfully in the reference, while the mutant's unreleased lock makes the second call revert.
change_summary: Delete `locked_ = false;` from the end of the modifier so the lock is never released and a second SetLogFile call reverts, leaving Log at its earlier value.
